Natural emergence and pursuit, swipe entry, shield-bounce reversal, recoil, ice-magic immunity, eighty-frame stun, repeated-stun rejection, split head/jaw debris, headless wandering, fire filter, lethal-stun delay, body breakup, size-dependent blue/red rupees, day/home-distance burial, deep-water defeat, idempotent pending-buffer cleanup, six-actor practice cap and scene teardown. native.fixture_limits: Separate debug save; adult player, camera and time pinned. Other Field enemies are cleared after safe placement succeeds. Damage and shield-bounce flags are supplied to the original handlers; health is restored to two before the nonlethal spin fixture. Water depth and flags are explicitly supplied, not an unassisted water encounter. The active swipe is blocked on its first observed active frame, so this does not count a full uninterrupted attack window. render_frames and headless_frames are draw-end observations with a live actor, not GPU draw counts. debris_frames counts individual live debris actors at draw end, not unique wall-clock frames. Native field spawner escalation and bunny-mask behavior were unchanged but not specifically exercised.
